verdict.rationale: Rootly documents an official MCP Server that exposes its incident data and actions as tools to any MCP-compatible client, including Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. Through it an agent can query incidents, check on-call schedules, find similar past incidents (e.g. the `find_related_incidents` tool), and take action. A probe confirms the official documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described, and documented MCP-specific setup and authentication steps (API-key generation is documented only for the general API).
